title: Create gdg-abq.zip skin for skinnable-tauri-demo
description:
Create a new skin file at `skinnable-tauri-demo/skins/gdg-abq.zip` themed for GDG (Google Developer Groups) Albuquerque.

Requirements:
- File path: `skinnable-tauri-demo/skins/gdg-abq.zip`
- Must be a valid skin: contains a top-level `styles.css` that is applied when the user uploads the zip via the Skin button (see `skinnable-tauri-demo/src/app/skinner.rs`).
- Incorporate GDG color palette (Google blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC04, green #34A853).
- Incorporate Albuquerque/New Mexico imagery: e.g. hot-air balloon (ABQ is the balloon capital) and/or the Zia sun symbol from the NM state flag.
- Rearrange the layout away from the default centered single-column. Be creative (e.g. card with colored border, balloon SVGs as logos, multicolor title).
- Since the skin can only ship CSS/assets (not HTML), use `h1::after { content: "GDG Albuquerque"; }` (with the original h1 hidden) to override the title text.
- Replace the Tauri/Yew logo images by setting `content: url(...)` on `.logo.tauri` and `.logo.yew`, with assets shipped inside the zip.
- Recommended structure inside the zip:
  - styles.css (entry; can @import other css)
  - gdg-abq.css (main rules)
  - balloon.svg (hot-air balloon)
  - zia.svg (Zia sun symbol — 4 ray groups of 4)
  - gdg-logo.svg (GDG mark in Google colors)
- Background should evoke an ABQ sunset/desert vibe (gradient sky), with Zia symbol watermark.
- Do NOT modify any source code outside the new zip and its temporary build tree.
- Reference existing skins (`bonus.zip`, `import.zip`) to confirm format. Build with `zip` CLI from a temp dir.

Files to read first:
- `CLAUDE.md`, `STYLE_GUIDE.md`, `RUST_STYLE_GUIDE.md` (style guides — note Rust guides do not apply to CSS assets but project conduct does)
- `skinnable-tauri-demo/styles.css` (defines base selectors: `.container`, `.logo.tauri`, `.logo.yew`, `h1`, `.row`, `#greet-input`, `button`)
- `skinnable-tauri-demo/src/app.rs` (DOM the CSS will style)
- `skinnable-tauri-demo/src/app/skinner.rs` (how the zip is loaded)

Acceptance:
- `unzip -l skinnable-tauri-demo/skins/gdg-abq.zip` lists at least `styles.css` and visual assets.
- `unzip -p skinnable-tauri-demo/skins/gdg-abq.zip styles.css` is valid CSS (no syntax errors).
- The skin visibly changes title text to 'GDG Albuquerque', uses Google's four colors somewhere prominent, and shows a balloon and/or Zia motif.
- Repo is clean except for the new zip file.
close_reason: Skin file created and verified. Judge: PASS.
